# termux-aichain Full Technical Specification (v0.1.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Sovereign Zero-Dependency AI Chaining and Agent Framework for Termux & Android Edge
Engineered under the Zero-Heavy-Dependency doctrine: Pure Python stdlib and pure Node.js ESM orchestration for local llama-server, BitNet 1-bit models, state graphs, and native Termux hardware APIs.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-aichain
- Command: pip install termux-aichain
# or for Node.js:
npm install @termux-ai/chain
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-aichain

## 3. Core Capabilities
- **Zero External Heavy Dependencies**: Pure Python standard library and pure Node.js ESM. Cold start import in under 18ms with less than 280KB disk footprint.
- **StateGraph & ReAct Engine**: Deterministic cyclic state machines and autonomous tool-calling loops (LangGraph lightweight alternative).
- **SQLite Long-Term Memory**: Persistent entity key-value storage and pure cosine vector search without ChromaDB or NumPy.
- **1-Line REST & SSE Server**: Exposes any agent or chain over local mobile WiFi with Server-Sent Events without FastAPI overhead.
- **CLI Tree Tracer & TPS Meter**: Hierarchical ANSI tree visualization, millisecond latency profiling, and token throughput meters.
- **Native Android Hardware Toolkit**: Direct tool-calling wrappers for Termux-API (battery status, sensors, GPS location, STT, TTS, vibration).

## 4. Canonical Implementation
```python
from termux_aichain import (
    BitNetChat,
    create_react_agent,
    get_default_device_tools,
    Tracer,
    HumanMessage
)

# 1. Connect to local 1-bit or GGUF LLM
llm = BitNetChat(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8088/v1", model="bitnet-b1.58-3b")

# 2. Compile ReAct Agent with native Android device tools
agent = create_react_agent(model=llm, tools=get_default_device_tools())

# 3. Profile execution with local CLI tracer
tracer = Tracer("EdgeMobileRun")
with tracer.trace("AgentExecution"):
    result = agent.invoke({"messages": [HumanMessage(content="Check battery and sensor status.")]})

tracer.finish()
tracer.print_tree()
print("Agent Output:", result["messages"][-1].content)

```
